trust_boundary.claim_acceptance: A source claim is usable for a decisive screen only when its exact locator and evidence artifact are recorded with a decisive read status.
trust_boundary.unknown_policy: Missing or unresolved evidence remains unknown and creates a property-resolution task; it is never coerced to false or treated as novelty.
trust_boundary.screen_scope: Applicability and bounded-negative decisions apply only to the named mechanism instance and never close an entire route by implication.
trust_boundary.authorization_boundary: Typed cells, generated seeds, and desk decisions authorize no experiment, target computation, route promotion, or security claim.

source_claims.citation: Amadori, Pintore, and Sala, On the Discrete Logarithm Problem for Prime-Field Elliptic Curves.

source_claims.statement: The source accumulates random points as its factor base and replaces repeated decompositions plus sparse linear algebra by one summation-polynomial system whose recovered point relation yields the discrete logarithm congruence.
source_claims.boundary: Its relative comparison with Petit assumes T(E,m,V) approximately T-prime(E,m,V); it explicitly does not claim work below p^(1/2), reports only 11-22-bit experiments, and leaves the single-system cost unresolved.

source_claims.citation: Faugere, Huot, Joux, Renault, and Vitse, EUROCRYPT 2014, Symmetrized Summation Polynomials.
source_claims.statement: A rational small-order torsion point can act coordinatewise on summation-polynomial variables; the relation-preserving subgroup can grow with the number of free variables.
source_claims.boundary: This is a mechanism and conditional complexity result for curves with the required rational torsion, not evidence that secp256k1 has that target property.

source_claims.citation: Lean GLV endomorphism order-divides-three theorem.
source_claims.statement: The secp256k1 map sending x to beta times x and preserving y is an additive automorphism whose cube is the identity.
source_claims.boundary: This theorem establishes that the order divides three, not that the map is nontrivial. Existence of the automorphism alone gives no asymptotic discrete-log improvement and does not imply independent coordinatewise covariance.

source_claims.citation: Lean secp256k1 GLV nonidentity theorem.
source_claims.statement: The secp256k1 GLV additive automorphism is not the identity.
source_claims.boundary: Together with the separate cube-is-identity theorem this gives exact order three. Nontriviality alone gives no asymptotic discrete-log improvement.

barriers.exact_scope: For nonsingular y^2=x^3+7 in characteristic not in {2,3,7}, the M16 input presentations and set-theoretic homogeneous projective S3 caterpillar semantics are exact, including identity, tangent, rational two-torsion, duplicate, extension-only, non-lift, topology, recovery, and GLV lift-sign strata. TASK-018 freezes the recursive projective S17 contract, including fixed degrees and the literal Sylvester determinant under the frozen coefficient, argument, and row order. TASK-019 kernel-checks the fixed-degree projective resultant common-root theorem, coefficient-map and algebraic-closure reflection variants, the literal TASK-018 Sylvester matrix bridge with coefficient unit 1, and its end-to-end common-root corollary, while retaining formal-degree drops, zero forms, affine witnesses, and [1:0]. TASK-020 kernel-checks the actual frozenC family, exact same-field and coefficient-map specialization at formal degrees (2^(s+1),2) with coefficient unit 1, separate affine [y:1] and infinity [1:0] branches, the universal output-degree bound, and the unconditional one-step common-projective-root equivalence. TASK-021 kernel-checks exact declared-degree projective evaluation and the all-stage frozen projective witness-chain equivalence, including the stage-14 C16 chain with fourteen intermediate projective slots and [1:0] allowed at every level. TASK-022 kernel-checks an exact literal finite MvPolynomial family for the frozen stage-14 predicate after injective base change: one GuardVar assignment satisfies every GuardedEquation, fourteen raw projective slots give 56 scalar variables, fifteen literal H equations plus fourteen nonzero-pair guards give 29 equation-family members, and every equation has total degree at most four. This family is equivalent to the recursive chain, not a parallel recursive syntax. The guards exclude [0:0] and retain [1:0]. TASK-023 kernel-checks an exact affine/infinity chart-polynomial cover: each InfinityMask I fixes selected slots to [1:0], gives one scalar [X_i:1] for every remaining slot, and has exactly 14 - I.card variables and fifteen H equations with base, internal-step, and final degree ceilings 2, 4, and 2. The existential cover is exactly equivalent to the projective chain, guarded system, and source frozen stage-14 predicate after the existing injective base change. The 2^14 logical masks are not enumerated or materialized. TASK-024 kernel-checks necessary infinity-stratum pruning: affine external inputs forbid adjacent infinity slots, so the exact cover restricts from 16384 masks to 987 separated masks. Selected boundary infinities satisfy endpoint determinant equations, and nonzero endpoint determinants conditionally restrict the exact cover to 377 interior masks. An isolated infinity forces each existing affine neighbor to q.u / q.v. These filters are necessary, not sufficient or unique, and the production mask families are not enumerated or materialized. TASK-025 kernel-checks explicit infinity propagation. Under its named nonvanishing assumptions the nested local mask family contracts from 377 to 129 after distance two, to 69 after distance three, and to 36 after also excluding the two boundary-near slots; the separate boundary-only refinement contracts 129 to 60 and is not the distance-three count. A one-way resultant implication propagates frozen projective chains over any field. Six prefix and six suffix obstruction values, with maximum frozen stage five, cover all twelve internal infinity slots. Under affine inputs, nonzero endpoint determinants, and BalancedPropagatedRegular, every solution mask is empty and both exact chart covers reduce to the single affine chart. The source-stage bridge still requires an injective map into an algebraically closed target and balanced regularity assumed for the mapped target data. Symbolic nonzeroness, nonemptiness, density, probability, and genericity of that regular locus are not proved; source-field computation does not automatically establish mapped-target regularity; no witness uniqueness or target-witness descent is claimed. These counts do not establish dimension, independent relations, rank, yield, or solving complexity. The barrier remains open on proving a nonempty usable regular locus or orchestrating its exceptional complement, then establishing usable relation yield and rank, solving degree and fill-in, preprocessing, sparse linear algebra, recovery cost, and total work. CQ-SEMAEV-S17-SYSTEM-COST remains partial and unpriced.
reopening_conditions: Starting from the exact TASK-023 affine/infinity chart-polynomial cover, completed TASK-024 necessary infinity-stratum filter, and completed TASK-025 conditional single-affine-chart theorem, either prove symbolic nonzeroness and nonemptiness for a usable mapped-target balanced regular locus or provide separately authorized orchestration of its exceptional complement without enumerating all 2^14 masks or sweeping the 987, 377, 129, 69, 60, or 36 logical families by default.
